# hivemind_forager_sandbox_providers (Data Source)

Sandbox runtimes enabled for the organization.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "hivemind_forager_sandbox_providers" "available" {}

output "sandbox_providers" {
  value = data.hivemind_forager_sandbox_providers.available.providers
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `default` (String) Organization default runtime name.
- `providers` (Attributes List) Runtimes enabled for the organization and their capabilities. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--providers))

<a id="nestedatt--providers"></a>
### Nested Schema for `providers`

Read-Only:

- `default` (Boolean) Whether this is the organization default runtime.
- `name` (String) Runtime name used in `sandbox_provider`.
- `secret_store` (Boolean) Whether this runtime supports sandbox secrets.
- `selectable` (Boolean) Whether users can select this runtime.
